Firestore auto-indexes single fields, so almost nothing in this game needs
an entry here: every other read is a direct document get. The one exception
is the global leaderboard, which asks for today's rows in score order.
⚠️ An un-indexed query returns an ERROR, not an empty list. Without this
deployed the board fails while every other feature looks perfectly healthy,
which is a confusing way to find out. Deploy it alongside firestore.rules.
